name: 最贵的无法购买的商品
englishName: Most Expensive Item That Can Not Be Bought
hints: Write out a few cases. It can be seen that all items greater than primeOne * primeTwo can always be bought.
If we can buy items with cost i, we can also buy items with price i + primeOne and i + primeTwo.
There is an O(1) solution: Use the Chicken McNugget Theorem.
